# Mutants of the scorecard's mutation metric (scripts/mutants.py, docs/mutants.md) that are EQUIVALENT: no test can tell them from the code. One per line, three TAB-separated fields:
#   id = file:line:col:old:new (line 1-based, col 0-based, as the runner numbers them) TAB reason (at least 20 characters; an entry with no reason does not count) TAB expiry (YYYY-MM-DD)
# scripts/mutants.py rejects an entry with no reason, an expired entry, an id that matches no mutant (the code moved), and an entry for a mutant the tests now kill. The score is killed / (killed + survivors that are not listed here).
